world.generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final wide 16:9 illustrated Egyptian Nile temple-market world scene for a Pepe-universe adventure game.
Input images: five attached character-design references from existing Rare Pepe token artwork, in order THOTHPEPE, GODDESSISIS, GODANUBIS, PEPEPHARAON, LORDKEK. The sixth design SPHINXPEPE is described below from its inspected original artwork. Reimagine these six existing characters as inhabitants of a shared world. Copy no card framing or typography.
Primary request: a lively, funny, lived-in nighttime Egyptian Nile temple market where these six distinct reference-anchored characters interact naturally. Strong horizontal landscape composition, warm readable characters, saturated lapis blue and teal, sandstone and coral accents, crescent moon over the Nile, papyrus and lotus reeds. Polished black-ink comic adventure illustration with rich color and tactile painted detail.
Character fidelity is essential:
1. THOTHPEPE: green Pepe face with a long thin downward-curving ibis-like beak projecting from his face, knowing half-lidded eyes, teal-blue Egyptian headdress, white robe and patterned collar. A witty scribe inspecting a papyrus scroll.
2. GODDESSISIS: green female frog face in an Egyptian headdress, magnificent broad outspread feathered wings in teal, cream and copper, ornate white patterned garment. Warm, composed host.
3. GODANUBIS: angular green jackal head with two tall pointed ears and long canine snout, blue striped lappets and blue Egyptian headdress, yellow-white wrap clothing. Preserve him as the jackal-headed green figure, not a generic frog.
4. SPHINXPEPE: reclining weathered sandstone lion-bodied sphinx with a green smiling Pepe face and sandy nemes headdress; seated to one side as a living stone market companion.
5. PEPEPHARAON: powerful muscular green Pepe pharaoh with stern red-lipped expression, colorful coral-yellow-blue striped nemes, striking yellow collar/armour and staff with subtle magic.
6. LORDKEK: seated rounded green Pepe frog, wide blue-and-sand striped nemes, grand amber-and-black wings, simple eye-shaped decorative motif nearby. Distinct from Isis's slender feathered wing silhouette.
Composition: all six figures visible and recognizable, each engaged in an amusing small interaction in the same coherent bustling temple market scene; no disconnected panels, no portrait collage. Let the architecture, Nile boats, baskets and papyrus stalls create a charming world around them. Each face must remain clear.
Constraints: character/environment illustration only. No newly invented cards, card frames, readable words, token names, logos, crypto symbols, prices, ownership labels, UI, or watermarks. Do not reproduce text or decorative card edges from the input images. Exactly one image.
